## Review checks

- [ ] Staged diff and whitespace reviewed; unrelated work preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, dumps, local fixtures or generated output.
- [ ] Public claims/media have evidence and approved use; concepts labelled.
- [ ] Documentation/contracts updated and historical evidence preserved.
- [ ] Deployment, production mutation and indexing remain separately gated.
